5 تضمّد It (a wound) was bound with a bandage or fillet [or kerchief (see 1)]. (K.) It (a man's head) was bound with a bandage or fillet [or kerchief] or with a piece of cloth, not a turban. (S.) ―
-b2- [And تضمّد بِهِ He used it, or applied it, as a poultice or the like.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
